rule: score = cos - 0.5 dims - 0.5 colour; unique best, precision >= 0.95 on held-out val frames
note: Fingerprint match threshold behind the navigation results: measured on held-out frames of the photo scene's walk (config1) and borrowed by the navigation memory scene. Copy to <runs>/<scene>/navigation/move_match.json, or point the scenes section of configs/navigation.json at it.
